headline: As of 2026-10-14: 4,778,110 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 35 of 50 states, D+23.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 4,778,110 early/mail ballots cast so far across 35 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+23.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Florida (635,382), Virginia (568,467), Michigan (520,417).
